text: Migrations time out where runtime queries do not because dotnet ef builds a fresh design-time DbContext with the provider's default 30s CommandTimeout. Your AddDbContext override does not reach it. Three fixes ranked by maintainability: provider-level o.CommandTimeout(600), Command Timeout=600 in the connection string, or Database.SetCommandTimeout before MigrateAsync. Error Number:-2 is the canonical client-side signal; 1222 is a different problem (lock wait).
